questions.question: What timestamp anchors feature availability for a training example?
What does a point-in-time join select?
options: The latest eligible feature available by the example cutoff
Every feature version for an entity
Only features created after the label

questions.question: Feature C42 has values 3 at 09:00 and 5 at 11:00. What value joins to a 10:00 prediction?
Why store both event time and availability time?
options: Availability time determines label maturity only
A fact can describe an earlier event but become usable later

questions.question: A lab sample is collected at 09:00 but published at 14:00. Can an 11:00 production prediction use it?
options: No, because it was not yet available
Yes, because event time is before prediction
Only if its value is positive

questions.question: Why can an end-of-day feature snapshot be wrong for a noon prediction?
options: It may include changes occurring after noon

questions.topic: Label Leakage: Learning from the Future
questions.question: What is label leakage?
options: A model with low training accuracy
Training inputs reveal information unavailable at prediction time or encode the outcome

questions.topic: Label Leakage: Learning from the Future
questions.question: Which support-ticket feature is likely to leak escalation?
options: Final resolution team assigned after escalation

questions.topic: Label Leakage: Learning from the Future
questions.question: Why fit imputation and normalization only on the training fold?
options: Full-dataset fitting exposes validation or test distribution

questions.topic: Label Leakage: Learning from the Future
questions.question: Why is random row splitting risky for repeated customers?
options: Random splits are always too small
The same entity's related examples can cross train and test

questions.topic: Label Leakage: Learning from the Future
questions.question: How should target encoding be computed for training rows?
options: Include each row's own target directly
Use the full test set labels
Use out-of-fold statistics that exclude the row's target
Assign every category its maximum label

questions.topic: Label Leakage: Learning from the Future
questions.question: Why can examples near the dataset end need exclusion?
options: Their future label window may not have matured

questions.question: What is training-serving skew?
options: Offline and online paths produce different feature semantics or values for the same prediction
The model has more training than test rows
The online store has low latency

questions.question: What should a feature definition specify besides its name?
options: Sources, transformation, keys, time logic, null policy, type, and version

questions.question: What does a parity test do?
options: Computes offline and online paths on identical inputs and compares outputs

questions.question: Why bind a model artifact to feature versions?
options: A model trained on V3 may misinterpret V4 values

questions.question: Offline missing values are null, while online missing values become zero. What is the likely consequence?
options: A semantic skew that can change model predictions

questions.question: What should training do when online features necessarily arrive with delay and missingness?
options: Train on corrected future truth only
Simulate the serving delay and missingness in historical features
